meta.note: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
meta.about: Words the German course and the Carinthian village's content use that the word packs don't have, for a learner of German without a German dictionary (a download, LANI_LEXICON_URL) and for the printed sheets: the verbs and their present forms (sein, haben, heißen), the personal pronouns, the articles (der, die, das; ein, eine), the numbers, the greetings. Austrian standard first (Jänner, Paradeiser, Grüß Gott, Servus, Baba), the German-German word named in the gloss. Each has its meaning in Slovene and Italian (meanings), the English in gloss, flagged machine-written. Each part of the German course appends its units' words. Opa Sepp's newer stories (the Prince's Stone, the Kufenstechen, the Nikolo and the Krampus, and the rest) and the corner's newer readings add every word their German lines use, so a tap on one means it: the everyday words (mit, man, nur, war, ging), the verbs' past forms, the places and names (Dobratsch, Karawanken, Myra) and the Slovene words they quote (štehvanje, prvi rej). Since 2026-11-02 (supplement-coverage) also every other word of Kärnten's content a tap met nothing for: the ten older stories, the chest's readings, the scenes, the project steps, the arrivals, the sky and the villagers' lines (Hütte, schmecken, Kasermandl, Laurentiustränen), each with the forms the content uses, made from its paradigm; the packs' words again where the pack lacks a form the content uses (Händen, fängt), with the pack's meanings; the interjections with a meaning (hm, juhu, oje, psst); the grammar book's terms and endings; and the Slovene words the German lines quote, said to be Slovene in every base (hvala, dober dan, kozolec). Since 2026-11-02 (parties-kaernten) also every word the five ages' parties use (the Firstfeier, the Dorffest, the Wiesenmarkt, the Stadtfest), with the forms they use. Since 2026-11-03 (course-de-b2-c) also the words of German B2's units 13-18, and spoken Carinthian to understand (lei, nit, eppes, ofn, miad, letz, losn, Pfiati), said to be spoken in every base. Since 2026-11-03 (packs-de) also every word the German B1 and B2 packs' titles and examples use (Nassfeld, Steuernummer, Hackschnitzel, Garnitzenklamm), with the forms they use; the packs' words in other forms with the pack's meanings (Bankomaten, Faschierten), a reflexive pack word's bare verb (verlieben for sich verlieben), and a separable verb's split forms under the base verb only. Since 2026-11-03 (dialogs-kaernten) also every word of the scenes' B1 and B2 variants a tap met nothing for (Wärmepumpe, Gespött, heroben, narrisch, Bezirkshauptmannschaft, the speech forms red, les, hat's, wir's), with the forms they use; the wrong forms the turns offer on purpose (heißte, schlafte, Deutscherin) stay out. Since 2026-11-03 (talks-de) also every word of the twelve German talks at B1 and B2 (companion/scenarios/de: the complaint, the Most, the surgery, the storm, the hearing aid, the Gasthaus, the mayor, the interview, the new doctor, the car, the slopes, Florian): their goals, openers and phrases, with the forms they use (Kassabon, Krankenstand, Pickerl, Typenschein, Nahversorger, Achterl, Kollektivvertrag, geronnen, hineingefahren). Since 2026-11-03 (readings-kaernten) also every word of Opa Sepp's B1 and B2 tellings and their notes and of the corner's B1 and B2 readings (the Lindwurm fountain, the Kranzelreiten, the Carnica, the Ratschen of Holy Week, the Gailtal alpine cheese), with the forms they use; the wrong forms the turns offer on purpose are left out. Since 2026-11-04 (village-b2-kaernten) also every word of the B1 and B2 tellings of the project steps, the B2 arrivals and the charcoal burner's cycle, with the forms they use; a wrong choice's form is a real form of the word (schärfenden, mauernder), so a tap on it means it too.
